stops.note: the Turkish name for the Stara Planina range that crosses Bulgaria
the geographer August Zeune extended the mountain name to the whole 'Balkan Peninsula' in 1808
said to have been coined by the editor J. L. Garvin, after the Ottoman Balkans broke into small warring states between 1878 and 1913

current_meaning: to divide a region or group into smaller, mutually hostile parts
